summary: The study investigates the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) growth of InP using trimethylindium (TMI) and tertiarybutylphosphine (TBP) in a horizontal atmospheric reactor. Self-limiting ALE growth was achieved at 340 °C, with monolayer saturation observed. The application of thin ALE InP layers (15 Å) on GaAs surfaces was explored, showing improved photoluminescence intensity and reduced surface recombination velocity.
evidence: Self-limiting ALE growth of InP was achieved at a growth temperature of 340 °C. The absence of arsenic oxide and an increase in the photoluminescence intensity by a factor of 2 were observed after InP passivation.
